name: Avanetco Dushanbe Data Center
notes: Commercial hosting provider Avanetco markets a Tajikistan VPS service from a data center it describes as located in Dushanbe. No public facility specifications, capacity, or independent verification were found; this is a small commercial hosting operation rather than a tiered colocation facility. Data Center Map and Baxtel list no commercial data centers in Tajikistan (per DCD, Oct 2025), so evidence is a provider marketing claim.

name: National Data Processing Center Complex at HPPs (government program)
developer: Government of Tajikistan (Ministry of Industry and New Technologies)
notes: In a 26 Nov 2025 interview with the newspaper Jumhuriyat, Minister of Industry and New Technologies Sherali Kabir said the government intends to create a large complex of data processing centers attached to the country's hydroelectric power stations, citing 98% green electricity generation and abundant water for cooling, and interest from large foreign AI companies. Part of the National AI Strategy (5% of GDP from AI by 2040). National-level announcement with no specific sites named; candidate HPP locations include Nurek (Khatlon), Rogun (districts of republican subordination) and Kayrakkum (Sughd). Recorded under Dushanbe as the seat of government.

name: darya.ai Darvoz Green AI Data Center (Area AI technopark / National AI Cluster)
notes: Tajikistan's (and Central Asia's) first green AI compute data center, located in Darvoz district of the Gorno-Badakhshan Autonomous Region (GBAO). The country's first NVIDIA H200 GPU cluster was inaugurated on 25 June 2025 under the patronage of President Emomali Rahmon; the site also hosts the National AI Cluster and the 'Area AI' technopark built by darya.ai. Powered by renewable hydropower. Per company statements the facility initially offers ~2 MW of power capacity with expansion to 100 MW planned in future phases.

name: darya.ai - Yotta Darvoz Green AI Data Center
developer: darya.ai Ltd & Yotta Data Services (Hiranandani Group)
notes: Strategic collaboration agreement signed 25 Oct 2025 on the sidelines of AI CONF 2025 in Dushanbe between darya.ai and India's Yotta Data Services to develop a green AI data center in Darvoz district, GBAO, powered entirely by renewable hydropower and housing NVIDIA GPUs for enterprises, government and startups. Described as a new facility separate from the darya.ai H200 cluster inaugurated in June 2025; first phase of a multi-stage plan to bridge South and Central Asian AI infrastructure. No capacity or timeline disclosed (Baxtel lists it as planned, target year ~2028).

Targeted searches for data center/datacenter/server farm projects in Khatlon region (Bokhtar/Kurgan-Tyube, Nurek, Sarband) found no facilities or confirmed projects. Data Center Map and Baxtel list no commercial data centers in Tajikistan. Context: the government's Nov 2025 announcement of data processing centers at major HPPs could implicate Nurek HPP (Khatlon), but no site has been designated. Absence based on negative search evidence.

No data center facilities or projects found in the Districts of Republican Subordination (DRS; incl. Hisor, Vahdat, Tursunzoda, Rudaki district). Tojiktelecom's new-format Communication Centers in Vahdat, Hisor, Tursunzade and Rudaki/Shahrinav districts are customer-service offices, not data centers, and IT Park Dushanbe is a startup free-zone platform without a public data center. Context: Rogun HPP (DRS) is a likely candidate under the government's announced HPP-attached data processing center program, but no site has been designated. Absence based on negative search evidence.

No data center facilities or confirmed projects found in Sughd region (incl. Khujand, the region's second-largest city, and the Kayrakkum HPP area). Data Center Map and Baxtel list no commercial data centers in Tajikistan. Context: Kayrakkum HPP (Sughd) is a potential candidate under the government's announced HPP-attached data center program (Nov 2025), but no site has been designated. Absence based on negative search evidence.
